news.title: Chancellor’s awards celebrate entrepreneurs advancing cancer care, feeding families, and building transformative companies
news.summary_en: This year, five alumni were recognized for their innovative pursuits and entrepreneurial spirit.

news.title: UW–Madison partners on new medical education campus to take on Wisconsin’s rural health care workforce shortage
news.summary_en: The joint initiative between UW–Madison, UW–La Crosse and Emplify Health by Gundersen will expand the pipeline of health care workers serving Wisconsin’s rural communities.

news.title: The promise of opportunity: A note from Rashid Bashir
news.summary_en: Chancellor-designate Bashir shares a greeting to the UW–Madison community.

news.title: What can $1 per paycheck do for Partners in Giving?
news.summary_en: Find out how impactful your gift to Partners in Giving really is, no matter its size. The campaign ends on Giving Tuesday, Dec. 1.

news.title: Rashid Bashir named chancellor of UW–Madison
news.summary_en: Bashir will begin his appointment as the university's 31st leader in February 2027.

news.title: Two Badgers were Rhodes Scholarship finalists
news.summary_en: Amitabha Shatdal and Andrew Dirkse reached the final stage of competition for a 2027 Rhodes Scholarship, one of the most prestigious and selective academic honors in the world.

news.title: UW–Madison selected to direct national transportation leadership development program
news.summary_en: Working with AASHTO, the university will develop and deliver training for transportation leaders nationwide beginning in 2027.
